caption: The drawing depicts a circular plate with a beige background and decorations executed primarily in brown and yellow tones. Inside the circle, at the center, there is a large floral motif with symmetrical leaves and petals. Above the flower are two birds perched on stylized branches, one above the other. To the left of the central motif, there is a human figure with short dark hair, wearing a skirt and a sleeveless top, holding a branch with leaves extending towards the upper bird. On the right side, opposite the human figure, is another figure with the body of a human but the head of a bird, also wearing a garment and a hat, and holding a violin or similar string instrument. Below the central flower, near the edge, is a small bird standing on the ground. Ornamental leaves and small floral patterns fill the background space between the main elements. The letters "E A R" and "C X M" are inscribed near the center, divided by a patterned rectangular shape. The overall composition is contained within the border of the circular plate, with a thin brown outline defining the perimeter.
title: Pa. German Plate
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
